summary: Platform for creators to sell digital products and memberships directly to customers.
access_note: Create an application in account settings and click Generate access token for your own account; OAuth for other users.

evidence.quote: Your access token is used in the request header of every request to the API and should be kept secret, like a password.
Instead, use the "Generate access token" button to get your access token.
Every assistant connects to its own URL and asks for OAuth access to your Gumroad account.

notes: The API reference page (gumroad.com/api) rendered only 'API' to the fetcher, so endpoint breadth comes from search results (products, sales, subscribers, offer codes) and not a vendor quote. Help article was read via curl.
